children: Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) posted rising inflows into its MSBT Bitcoin fund and unveiled a 2027 comp plan and advisor pay grid while converting muni funds to ETFs, expanding AI and capital-markets work, backing energy and tech deals, and aiding restructurings as it grows AUM and fee share.
Previous Week Recap
MSBT Bitcoin Fund Inflows Grow
: Morgan Stanley (MS) reported that its MSBT Bitcoin fund holdings exceeded $609 million as inflows continued, with client demand cited as the source of the ongoing contributions to the fund.
Eight Muni Funds To ETFs
: Morgan Stanley (MS) plans to convert eight municipal-bond mutual funds (~$10B AUM) into ETFs pending shareholder approval; seven to new active muni ETFs, one into Eaton Vance EVSM.
2027 Comp Plan; Wealth AUM
: Morgan Stanley (MS) released its 2027 comp plan and reported $6.3T in Wealth Management AUM as of June 30, with advisor-led client assets up 24% year‑over‑year.
MS, Goldman Share Investment Fees
: Morgan Stanley (MS) and Goldman Sachs took about 25% of global investment banking fees through Sept. 15, up from 19% a year earlier; MS part of the combined fee share.
AI Slowdown Won’t Diminish Demand
: Morgan Stanley (MS) says AI slowdown won’t cut demand for compute or chips. Capital markets ready for big M&A and IPOs. Firm expanding AI work in research, cybersecurity, customer service.
AirBaltic DIP Financing Support
: Morgan Stanley (MS) is providing part of €350M debtor-in-possession financing to AirBaltic as it files Chapter 11 in New York to fund operations amid higher fuel costs and geopolitical pressure.
NSE Stake Sale Cut To Final Size
: Morgan Stanley cut its stake sale in NSE during the IPO anchor book, helping set the final issue size at Rs.22,569 crore.
2027 Advisor Pay Grid Unveiled
: Morgan Stanley (MS) unveiled its 2027 advisor pay grid: revenue thresholds up ~10% across 16 bands; overall payout range stays 28%–55.5%; incentives preserved to reward growth and firm leverage
Amber Electric €49M Series E
: Morgan Stanley’s investment arm led a €49M Series E for Amber Electric, backing its expansion into Europe and AI-driven real-time optimization of distributed energy resources.
Retirement Bonuses For Long-Serving Advisors
: Morgan Stanley raised retirement bonuses in its Advisor Legacy Program for advisors with 30+ years, part of broader hiring and retention moves to keep long-tenured financial advisers at the firm.
